title: UnoRebuilt
description: The recommended resource pack for the UnoRebuilt plugin
body:
This lightweight resource pack enables the [UnoRebuilt](https://modrinth.com/plugin/unorebuilt) plugin to use individual textures for UNO cards by making use of custom model data.

Instead of being installed by every player individually, the plugin can also be configured as a server resource pack by specifying the following lines in the `server.properties` file:
```properties
resource-pack=https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PppCCzHq/versions/osh4w5Xn/UnoRebuilt.zip
resource-pack-sha1=E22666ED1A6D42E29D178B379CAB3DB2BAC27F16
```

If you are already using a server resource pack, you can also use Itsme64's [Texture Pack Merger](https://www.convertmcpack.net/merger.php) to combine it with this pack.

Without custom model data being provided either by the plugin or by commands, no changes will be visible from this resource pack.
